verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control tool, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer user-defined event rules, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only fixed built-in behaviors and single toggles: Launch at Login, automatic network handoff when you get home, and a daily update check. None of these is a facility for defining your own rules that trigger actions on events, so they are adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
